title: An Interpretable Latency Model for Speculative Decoding in LLM Serving
authors: Linghao Kong; Megan Flynn; Michael Peng; Nir Shavit; Mark Kurtz; Alexandre Marques
research_focus: Speculative decoding, MoE serving, Multi-tenant scheduling, Continuous batching, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Roofline analysis

problem_statement.en: Speculative decoding (SD) is typically evaluated in isolated or fixed-batch settings, but production serving systems such as vLLM use continuous batching, so request load varies over time and the effective batch size emerges from the scheduler rather than being directly controlled. As a result, SD speedups observed in single-stream benchmarks often diminish, vanish, or reverse under realistic serving load, and prior work lacks an interpretable model that links request rate, acceptance rate, and draft length to end-to-end latency.
problem_statement.zh: Speculative decoding (SD) 過往多在 single-stream 或固定 batch 的情境下評估，但生產級服務系統如 vLLM 採用 continuous batching，請求負載隨時間變動，effective batch size 由 scheduler 動態決定而非外部設定。因此 single-stream 量測到的 SD 加速在實際負載下往往逐漸衰減、消失甚至反轉，而既有研究缺乏一個能將 request rate、acceptance rate、draft length 與端到端延遲串接起來的可解釋模型。

key_innovation.en: A closed-form, speculation-aware latency model derived from a roofline-style decomposition L = C1 + B x C2 combined with Little's Law (B = RPS x L), yielding L = C1 / (1 - RPS x C2). The framework decomposes per-request demand into load-independent and load-dependent components for prefill, drafting, and verification, then introduces an MoE-aware extension that scales coefficients by an expert-coverage factor phi(T) = 1 - (1 - m/M)^T.
key_innovation.zh: 以 roofline 風格分解 L = C1 + B x C2，結合 Little's Law (B = RPS x L) 推出封閉式 speculation-aware 延遲模型 L = C1 / (1 - RPS x C2)。該框架將 per-request demand 拆解為與負載無關與隨負載變動的兩個部分，分別對應 prefill、drafting、verification 三個階段，並提出 MoE-aware 延伸：以 expert-coverage 因子 phi(T) = 1 - (1 - m/M)^T 對各係數進行修正。

baselines_compared: Vanilla autoregressive decoding (no SD), EAGLE-3 SD, Vanilla multi-model SD (independent drafter)

key_improvements.en: Demonstrates universal latency collapse onto y = 1/(1 - x) with R^2 close to 1.00 across Llama-3.1-8B/70B, Qwen3-0.6B/1.7B/4B/8B/14B/32B, gpt-oss-20b, Qwen3-30B-A3B, and Qwen3-235B-A22B. Leave-n-out generalization preserves R^2 close to the full-data fit on Qwen3-8B/14B/32B for held-out prefill-decode configurations. MoE-aware extension raises low-load R^2 from 0.902 to 0.997 for gpt-oss-20b, 0.830 to 0.976 for Qwen3-30B-A3B, and 0.906 to 0.989 for Qwen3-235B-A22B.
key_improvements.zh: 在 Llama-3.1-8B/70B、Qwen3 系列（0.6B、1.7B、4B、8B、14B、32B）、gpt-oss-20b、Qwen3-30B-A3B 與 Qwen3-235B-A22B 上，所有量測 collapse 至 y = 1/(1 - x) 曲線，R^2 接近 1.00。Leave-n-out 泛化測試在 Qwen3-8B/14B/32B 的未見 prefill/decode 配置下，預測 R^2 仍接近完整資料擬合。MoE-aware 延伸把低負載段 R^2 從 gpt-oss-20b 的 0.902 提升至 0.997、Qwen3-30B-A3B 從 0.830 提升至 0.976、Qwen3-235B-A22B 從 0.906 提升至 0.989。

gpu_count: 1x A100 SXM (most experiments); 4x A100 SXM (Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct); 8x A100 SXM (Qwen3-235B-A22B); 1x H100 (robustness check)
reported_accuracy: R^2 close to 1.00 on most Qwen3/Llama-3.1 configurations; R^2 of 0.997 for gpt-oss-20b and 0.989 for Qwen3-235B-A22B under MoE-aware extension
models_validated: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, Qwen3-0.6B, Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, Qwen3-32B, gpt-oss-20b, Qwen3-30B-A3B, Qwen3-235B-A22B
validation_workloads: Synthetic (Jane Austen's Pride and Prejudice, prefill/decode lengths {256, 512, 768, 1024}, sweeps over acceptance rate 50%-100% and draft length 1-10)

scope_assumptions.en: Targets the stable pre-saturation regime; excludes the saturation boundary where preemption makes latency unstable. Fits mean latency, with P95/P99 covered as an extension. Fitted coefficients are system-specific (GPU, parallelism strategy, scheduler, serving engine); model is treated as a lightweight profiling framework rather than a universal set of constants. Adaptive drafting and tree verification may introduce additional cost terms not captured. Acceptance process modeled as a constant per-token probability alpha, independent of position.
scope_assumptions.zh: 模型專注於 stable pre-saturation 區段，排除接近 saturation boundary 因 preemption 造成的不穩定。主要擬合 mean latency，P95 與 P99 視為延伸。擬合得到的係數與系統綁定（GPU、平行化策略、scheduler、serving engine），論文將模型定位為輕量級 profiling 框架而非通用常數表。Adaptive drafting 與 tree verification 等機制可能引入未被建模的額外成本項目。Acceptance 過程被建模為與位置無關、常數的 per-token 機率 alpha。
